# UpdateOptionValueRequest

- Namespace/type: `PPDS.Dataverse.Metadata.Authoring.UpdateOptionValueRequest`
- Assembly: `PPDS.Dataverse`

## Summary

Request to update an existing option value in an option set. Target the option by P:PPDS.Dataverse.Metadata.Authoring.UpdateOptionValueRequest.Value or P:PPDS.Dataverse.Metadata.Authoring.UpdateOptionValueRequest.Label (exactly one); P:PPDS.Dataverse.Metadata.Authoring.UpdateOptionValueRequest.NewLabel carries the updated label (#1170).
